metrics.description: Average of Total Sales Amount (Daily Store Sales) in the current report, dashboard, and filter context.

metrics.description: Average of Total Sales Amount (Daily Store Sales) in the current report, dashboard, and filter context.

metrics.description: Measures the average revenue generated per sales order, calculated as total Revenue divided by total Order Count. Use it to track typical order size and compare performance across time periods, customers, products, or regions.
metrics.title: Average Order Value

metrics.description: Average revenue generated per online order, calculated as total online order revenue divided by the number of online orders. Use this metric to track typical order size and compare purchasing behavior across time periods or business segments.
metrics.title: Average Order Value (Online Orders)

metrics.description: Returns the maximum value of total kWh consumed within the selected data and filters.
metrics.title: Maximum Total kWh Consumed

metrics.description: Sums the total number of inventory age days across all records in the Aged Inventory dataset to quantify overall inventory aging. Use it with attributes like product or location to pinpoint where older stock is concentrated.
metrics.title: Total Age Days (Aged Inventory)

metrics.description: Shows the overall average checkout time in seconds by summing the “Avg Checkout Time (sec)” values from the Checkout Time dataset. Use it to monitor checkout speed and compare efficiency across the currently selected filters or segments.
metrics.title: Total Avg Checkout Time (sec) (Checkout Time)

metrics.description: Totals the Competitor Price values from the Competitor Pricing dataset, showing the overall competitor pricing amount for the current selections and breakdowns. Use it to compare competitor pricing levels across products, time periods, or other dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Competitor Price (Competitor Pricing)

metrics.description: Counts the total number of comments recorded across compliment/complaint entries by summing the Comment Count from the Compliment Complaint data. Use it to track and compare overall comment volume for customer compliments and complaints.
metrics.title: Total Comment Count (Compliment Complaint)

metrics.description: Shows total operating expenses (Operating Expenses (OpEx) by summing Operating Expenses (OpEx) from the Daily Profit & Loss data for the current reporting context, such as the selected date range, business unit, or other applied filters.
metrics.title: Total OpEx (Daily Profit & Loss)

metrics.description: Shows the total average transaction value by summing the Avg Transaction Value from the Daily Store Sales data across the selected records. Use it to track overall transaction value trends over time or compare totals across stores, regions, or other groupings.
metrics.title: Total Avg Transaction Value (Daily Store Sales)

metrics.description: Sums Sales Amount from the Daily Store Sales dataset to show total sales value for the selected scope (for example by time period, store, or other filters). Use it as a core measure for tracking and comparing overall sales performance.
metrics.title: Total Sales Amount (Daily Store Sales)

metrics.description: Total number of store sales transactions, calculated by summing Transaction Count from the Daily Store Sales data. Use it to track store activity volume and compare performance across time, stores, or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Transaction Count (Daily Store Sales)

metrics.description: Shows the total cost of energy consumption within the current analysis scope (such as applied filters and the selected time period). Use it to track overall spending and compare energy-consumption costs across different groups or periods.
metrics.title: Total Cost (Energy Consumption)

metrics.description: Sums energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) to show the total amount of electricity used. Use this metric to track overall energy usage and compare consumption across different slices of the Energy Consumption data.
metrics.title: Total kWh (Energy Consumption)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of gift card transactions by summing the Transaction Count from the Gift Card Transaction dataset. Use it to monitor overall gift card transaction volume across the time periods and business dimensions you select.
metrics.title: Total Transaction Count (Gift Card Transaction)

metrics.description: Sums all loyalty points redeemed across transactions to show overall redemption volume. Use it to monitor redemption trends over time or break down redeemed points by customer, program, or other available dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Points Redeemed (Loyalty Points Redeemed)

metrics.description: Shows the total monetary value of rewards customers have redeemed by summing Reward Value from the Loyalty Points Redeemed data. Use it to monitor overall redemption value over time or compare redemption value across customer segments.
metrics.title: Total Reward Value (Loyalty Points Redeemed)

metrics.description: Shows the total monetary value of discounts redeemed through loyalty redemptions at the point of sale by summing the Discount Amount across Loyalty Redemption at POS transactions. Use it to monitor the overall impact of loyalty redemption discounts over a selected period, store set, or customer segment.
metrics.title: Total Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS)

metrics.description: Shows the total value of operating expense transactions by summing the Amount from Operating Expense Transaction records for the current report filters and time period.
metrics.title: Total Amount (Operating Expense Transaction)

metrics.description: Sums the Price Change amounts from Price Adjustment records to show the total net impact of price adjustments for the current analysis slice (such as by time, product, or customer). Use this metric to quantify how much pricing actions increased or decreased prices in aggregate.
metrics.title: Total Price Change (Price Adjustment)

metrics.description: Sums the PO Amount to show the total value of purchase orders. Use it to track and compare overall purchasing spend across time, suppliers, or other reporting dimensions.
metrics.title: Total PO Amount (Purchase Order)

metrics.description: Tracks the total number of purchase orders by summing the PO Count from the Purchase Order dataset. Use it to monitor overall PO volume and compare it across time periods or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Total PO Count (Purchase Order)

metrics.description: Sums the line amounts across purchase order line items to show total purchase spend. Use it to track overall spend and compare totals across time, suppliers, products, or other dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Line Amount (Purchase Order Line Items)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of units ordered by summing Quantity across all purchase order line items. Use it to track overall purchasing volume and compare ordered quantities across dimensions such as supplier, product, or time.
metrics.title: Total Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items)

metrics.description: Tracks the total number of units returned by summing the “Quantity Returned” values from the Returns dataset. Use it to monitor overall return volume and compare returns across time periods or other business breakdowns.
metrics.title: Total Quantity Returned (Returns)

metrics.description: Shows the total value of returned items by summing Return Amount from the Returns dataset, within the current report scope (such as by time period, product, or customer). Use it to track and analyze returns volume and trends across different slices of the business.
metrics.title: Total Return Amount (Returns)

metrics.description: Totals the variance amount from Till Reconciliation to quantify the overall cash over/short (discrepancy) across the selected records. Use it to monitor reconciliation variances and analyze them by time, store, cashier, or other relevant dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Variance Amount (Till Reconciliation)

metrics.description: Shows total revenue by summing the Revenue fact from the Blended Daily Revenue dataset, reflecting whatever filters and time period are currently selected.
metrics.title: Total Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue)

metrics.description: Shows the total revenue attributed to the loyalty program by summing Attributed Revenue from the Loyalty Program ROI dataset within the currently selected filters and scope.
metrics.title: Total Attributed Revenue (Loyalty Program ROI)

metrics.description: Tracks the total cost associated with loyalty points by summing the Points Cost from the Loyalty Program ROI dataset. Use it to monitor the overall expense of points issued or redeemed as part of the loyalty program.
metrics.title: Total Points Cost (Loyalty Program ROI)

metrics.description: Sums Net Revenue from the Net Sales Summary dataset to show total net revenue for the current report or dashboard context, respecting the selected filters and breakdowns.
metrics.title: Total Net Revenue (Net Sales Summary)

metrics.description: Totals Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) from the Daily Profit & Loss data to show overall direct costs for the currently selected period and any applied filters.
metrics.title: Total COGS

metrics.description: Totals the Revenue from the Daily Profit & Loss dataset to show net revenue for the current reporting scope, such as the selected time period and any applied filters.
metrics.title: Total Net Revenue

metrics.description: Tracks the total number of online orders by summing the Order Count from the Online Order dataset. Use it to monitor overall order volume and compare order activity across time periods, channels, or customer segments.
metrics.title: Total Order Count

metrics.description: Calculates the number of orders per unit of net revenue in the current reporting scope, showing how order volume scales relative to revenue. Useful for comparing order-to-revenue intensity across time periods or filtered segments.
metrics.title: Order Count per Net Revenue

metrics.description: Shows how much net revenue you generate for each unit of loyalty discount redeemed at the point of sale, calculated as Total Net Revenue divided by Total Discount Amount from POS loyalty redemptions. Use this to evaluate the revenue efficiency or payback of POS loyalty redemptions across the selected time period, stores, or customer segments.
metrics.title: Net Revenue per Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS)

metrics.description: Shows how large your Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) is relative to energy consumption spending by dividing total COGS by total energy consumption cost for the current filters and time period. Use it to compare this cost relationship across groups or over time.
metrics.title: COGS per Cost (Energy Consumption)

metrics.description: Shows how many orders you get per unit of returned value by dividing Total Order Count by Total Return Amount (Returns). Use it to relate order volume to returns value within the current slice (for example by time period, product, or customer segment).
metrics.title: Order Count per Return Amount (Returns)

metrics.description: Shows the average net revenue per unit returned by dividing Total Net Revenue by Total Quantity Returned. Use it to assess the revenue impact of returns and compare this ratio across time periods or business segments.
metrics.title: Net Revenue per Quantity Returned (Returns)

metrics.description: Shows Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) relative to average transaction value by dividing total COGS by the summed average transaction value across the current selection. Use this to compare how direct product costs scale with transaction value over time or across stores and regions.
metrics.title: COGS per Avg Transaction Value (Daily Store Sales)

metrics.description: Shows the number of orders generated per unit of revenue by dividing Total Order Count by Total Revenue from the Blended Daily Revenue dataset. Use this ratio to compare how efficiently revenue translates into order volume under the current filters and time period.
metrics.title: Order Count per Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue)

metrics.description: Shows how net revenue from the Daily Profit & Loss source compares to net revenue from the Net Sales Summary source by expressing the former as a ratio of the latter. Use it to validate that the two sources align in the current reporting context and to spot differences caused by filters or scope.
metrics.title: Net Revenue per Net Revenue (Net Sales Summary)

metrics.description: Measures the cost of goods sold per loyalty point redeemed by dividing Total COGS by Total Points Redeemed. Use it to assess the direct cost efficiency of redemption activity and compare performance across time periods or business segments.
metrics.title: COGS per Points Redeemed (Loyalty Points Redeemed)

metrics.description: Shows how many orders occur per unit of net price change by dividing Total Order Count by Total Price Change from price adjustments. Use it to relate order volume to the overall impact of pricing actions when analyzing by time, product, customer, or other slices.
metrics.title: Order Count per Price Change (Price Adjustment)

metrics.description: Shows how much net revenue corresponds to each unit of till reconciliation variance by dividing Total Net Revenue by the Total Variance Amount (Till Reconciliation). Use it to put cash over/short discrepancies in context and compare reconciliation performance across time periods, stores, or other slices.
metrics.title: Net Revenue per Variance Amount (Till Reconciliation)

metrics.description: Compares your total Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) to the total competitor price for the current selection, showing how your direct costs stack up against competitor pricing levels. Use it to benchmark cost positioning across the same filters and breakdowns (e.g., by product or time period).
metrics.title: COGS per Competitor Price (Competitor Pricing)

metrics.description: Measures order throughput relative to checkout speed by dividing Total Order Count by the total average checkout time (in seconds). Use it to compare how efficiently orders are placed across time periods or customer segments under the current filters.
metrics.title: Order Count per Avg Checkout Time (sec) (Checkout Time)

metrics.description: Compares overall net revenue to the revenue attributed to the loyalty program by expressing how much net revenue is generated for each unit of loyalty-attributed revenue under the current filters. Use it to gauge loyalty program ROI in context—higher values indicate more net revenue relative to what is credited to the program.
metrics.title: Net Revenue per Attributed Revenue (Loyalty Program ROI)

metrics.description: Measures how much net revenue is generated for each unit of reward value redeemed through loyalty points, helping assess the efficiency of redemptions. Use it to compare revenue return on redeemed value across time periods, customer segments, or other reporting cuts.
metrics.title: Net Revenue per Reward Value (Loyalty Points Redeemed)

metrics.description: Compares order volume to net revenue within the same reporting scope by taking the difference between Total Order Count and Total Net Revenue under the current time period and filters. Use it as a quick directional check on whether changes in orders are tracking alongside changes in revenue.
metrics.title: Order Count vs Net Revenue Change

metrics.description: Calculates net revenue after subtracting the total discount amount redeemed through loyalty redemptions at the point of sale. Use this metric to assess how loyalty POS discounts reduce net revenue within the current reporting scope (for example by time period, store, or customer segment).
metrics.title: Net Revenue vs Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS) Change

metrics.description: Compares loyalty discount value redeemed at the point of sale against overall purchasing volume by calculating the difference between total loyalty redemption discount amount and total purchase order line item quantity. Use it to understand how loyalty discount impact shifts relative to ordered units within the same selected filters (for example, time period or business segment).
metrics.title: Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS) vs Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items) Change

metrics.description: Compares purchasing volume to energy spending by calculating the difference between total purchase order line item quantity and total energy consumption cost for the current filters and time period. Use it to assess whether ordered units are increasing faster or slower than energy cost levels when analyzing by supplier, product, or time.
metrics.title: Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items) vs Cost (Energy Consumption) Change

metrics.description: Calculates the net change between total Energy Consumption cost and the total Return Amount by subtracting returns from energy spending within the current filters and time period. Use it to see whether energy-related costs outweigh returns and to compare that balance across groups or over time.
metrics.title: Cost (Energy Consumption) vs Return Amount (Returns) Change

metrics.description: Shows the difference between the total value of returns and the total number of units returned within the current report scope. Use it as a quick indicator of whether return dollars are rising or falling relative to return volume when comparing across time, products, or customers.
metrics.title: Return Amount (Returns) vs Quantity Returned (Returns) Change

metrics.description: Net change indicator comparing return volume to sales value for the selected scope, calculated as total units returned minus total sales amount. Use it to spot periods or segments where returns outweigh sales value (or vice versa) alongside the underlying returns and sales totals.
metrics.title: Quantity Returned (Returns) vs Sales Amount (Daily Store Sales) Change

metrics.description: Shows the difference between total sales value and total number of transactions from the Daily Store Sales data for the current selection (such as time period or store). Use it to see whether sales dollars are running ahead of—or behind—transaction volume in the filtered context.
metrics.title: Sales Amount (Daily Store Sales) vs Transaction Count (Daily Store Sales) Change

metrics.description: Compares transaction volume to average transaction value by calculating the difference between Total Transaction Count and Total Avg Transaction Value using Daily Store Sales data. Use it to see whether transaction activity is increasing or decreasing relative to changes in average transaction value across the selected stores, regions, or time period.
metrics.title: Transaction Count (Daily Store Sales) vs Avg Transaction Value (Daily Store Sales) Change

metrics.description: Compares overall transaction value to overall revenue by calculating the difference between total Avg Transaction Value (from Daily Store Sales) and total Revenue (from Blended Daily Revenue) in the current reporting context. Use it to track how the gap between these two totals shifts across filters, time periods, or segments.
metrics.title: Avg Transaction Value (Daily Store Sales) vs Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue) Change

metrics.description: Calculates the gap between Total Revenue from the Blended Daily Revenue source and Total Net Revenue from the Net Sales Summary in the current report or dashboard context. Use it to quantify how much these two revenue figures diverge for the selected filters, time period, and breakdowns.
metrics.title: Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue) vs Net Revenue (Net Sales Summary) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between Total Net Revenue (Net Sales Summary) and Total Amount (Operating Expense Transaction) in the current report or dashboard context. Use it to see whether net revenue is higher or lower than operating expense transaction amounts for the selected filters and time period.
metrics.title: Net Revenue (Net Sales Summary) vs Amount (Operating Expense Transaction) Change

metrics.description: Calculates the net difference between total Operating Expense Transaction amount and the total number of Gift Card Transactions for the current filters and time period. Use it to compare how operating expense value is tracking versus gift card transaction volume, where a positive result means expenses are higher than transaction count and a negative result means the opposite.
metrics.title: Amount (Operating Expense Transaction) vs Transaction Count (Gift Card Transaction) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between total gift card transaction count and total loyalty points redeemed for the selected slices and time period. Use it to see whether gift card activity is outpacing or lagging loyalty redemption activity in the same view.
metrics.title: Transaction Count (Gift Card Transaction) vs Points Redeemed (Loyalty Points Redeemed) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between loyalty points redeemed and the total impact of price adjustments for the selected slice (for example by time, product, or customer). Use it to compare redemption volume against pricing adjustment impact and understand which effect is larger.
metrics.title: Points Redeemed (Loyalty Points Redeemed) vs Price Change (Price Adjustment) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between total price changes from price adjustments and total till-reconciliation variance for the selected slice. Use it to compare the overall impact of pricing actions against cash over/short discrepancies and see which is larger.
metrics.title: Price Change (Price Adjustment) vs Variance Amount (Till Reconciliation) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between the total till reconciliation variance amount (cash over/short) and the total number of compliment/complaint comments for the current selection. Use it to see whether reconciliation discrepancies are rising or falling relative to customer feedback volume when analyzing by time, store, or other dimensions.
metrics.title: Variance Amount (Till Reconciliation) vs Comment Count (Compliment Complaint) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net change between total compliment/complaint comment volume and total aged inventory days. Use it as a directional indicator to see whether customer feedback activity is rising or falling relative to overall inventory aging when slicing by dimensions like product or location.
metrics.title: Comment Count (Compliment Complaint) vs Age Days (Aged Inventory) Change

metrics.description: Calculates the difference between total inventory age days and total competitor price for the current selection. Use it to compare where inventory is aging more heavily relative to the competitive price environment and to spot mismatches between aging stock and competitor pricing levels.
metrics.title: Age Days (Aged Inventory) vs Competitor Price (Competitor Pricing) Change

metrics.description: Compares total competitor pricing against total average checkout time (in seconds) by calculating the difference between the two for the current selections and filters. Use it to see how competitor price levels move relative to checkout speed and to track changes in the gap across segments or time.
metrics.title: Competitor Price (Competitor Pricing) vs Avg Checkout Time (sec) (Checkout Time) Change

metrics.description: Compares checkout speed to loyalty-program performance by subtracting total loyalty-program-attributed revenue from the overall checkout time in seconds for the current filters and scope. Use it to look at how changes in operational checkout efficiency move alongside loyalty-program ROI in the same analysis.
metrics.title: Avg Checkout Time (sec) (Checkout Time) vs Attributed Revenue (Loyalty Program ROI) Change

metrics.description: Shows the difference between the total number of purchase orders and the total purchase order amount, helping you compare changes in purchasing volume versus spend. Use it to spot time periods or segments where PO counts and PO value move in different directions.
metrics.title: PO Count (Purchase Order) vs PO Amount (Purchase Order) Change

metrics.description: Shows the difference between the total Purchase Order header amount and the summed line-item amounts for the same purchase orders. Use it to spot and quantify discrepancies between header-level PO values and underlying line items when analyzing purchasing spend across dimensions like time or supplier.
metrics.title: PO Amount (Purchase Order) vs Line Amount (Purchase Order Line Items) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and Operating Expenses (OpEx) for the current reporting context in the Daily Profit & Loss data. Use it to understand whether direct costs or operating costs are driving spending changes over the selected period and filters.
metrics.title: COGS vs OpEx (Daily Profit & Loss) Change

metrics.description: Measures the total number of units returned, filtered to the North region. Use it to track and compare return volume for North across time periods or other business breakdowns.

metrics.description: Counts the total number of store sales transactions for stores in the North region. Use it to monitor North-region transaction volume over time or compare against other regions’ transaction counts.

metrics.description: Shows the average transaction value for Daily Store Sales restricted to the Online sales channel. Use it to monitor or compare how online transaction values perform over time or across other business dimensions.

metrics.description: Average transaction value from the Daily Store Sales data, filtered to stores in the North region. Use it to monitor and compare transaction value performance or trends for the North region against other regions or segments.
metrics.title: Avg Transaction Value (Daily Store Sales) — North Region

metrics.description: Totals revenue from the Blended Daily Revenue source for the In-Store sales channel only. Use it to track and compare in-store revenue across the selected time period and any other analysis filters.
metrics.title: Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows total blended daily revenue for the Online sales channel only. Use this metric to track and compare online revenue performance within the current reporting context (such as the active filters and time period).
metrics.title: Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total revenue from the Blended Daily Revenue data limited to the North region. Use this metric to report North-only revenue while still honoring the currently selected dashboard/report filters and time period.
metrics.title: Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue) — North Region

Use it to track in-store order momentum alongside how revenue compares to loyalty discounts redeemed at the point of sale over the same reporting scope.
metrics.title: MoM: Order Count — In-Store Channel (+Net Revenue/Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS))

metrics.description: Combines the year-over-year change in Online Channel order count with the average loyalty redemption discount per purchased unit (total POS loyalty discount amount divided by total purchase-order quantity). Use it as a composite indicator to relate online order growth/decline to how much discount value is being redeemed per unit over the same slice of data.
metrics.title: YoY: Order Count — Online Channel (+Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS)/Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items))

metrics.description: Combines the month-over-month change in online order count with an efficiency-style adjustment that divides total purchased quantity by total energy-consumption cost. Use it as a single indicator to monitor whether online order volume is rising or falling while factoring in purchasing volume relative to energy spending within the current filters and time period.
metrics.title: MoM: Order Count — Online Channel (+Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items)/Cost (Energy Consumption))

metrics.description: Combines the year-over-year growth rate of Order Count in the North region with a cost-to-returns ratio (Total Energy Consumption Cost divided by Total Return Amount). Use it as a composite indicator to view North’s order momentum alongside operational cost pressure relative to returns within the current filters and time period.
metrics.title: YoY: Order Count — North Region (+Cost (Energy Consumption)/Return Amount (Returns))

metrics.description: Combines the month-over-month change in online order count for the North region with the average value per returned unit (total return amount divided by total quantity returned). Use it to monitor how North’s order-volume trend relates to return value intensity over the selected reporting period.
metrics.title: MoM: Order Count — North Region (+Return Amount (Returns)/Quantity Returned (Returns))

metrics.description: Extends the year-over-year Net Revenue change for the In-Store channel by adding a returns-to-sales ratio (total quantity returned divided by total sales amount). Use it to view YoY in-store revenue performance while factoring in return volume relative to sales.
metrics.title: YoY: Net Revenue — In-Store Channel (+Quantity Returned (Returns)/Sales Amount (Daily Store Sales))

metrics.description: Combines the month-over-month change in In-Store Net Revenue with the average sales per transaction (Total Sales Amount divided by Total Transaction Count) for the current filter context. Use it to understand how in-store revenue trends month to month alongside the typical transaction value.
metrics.title: MoM: Net Revenue — In-Store Channel (+Sales Amount (Daily Store Sales)/Transaction Count (Daily Store Sales))

metrics.description: Composite metric that adjusts the year-over-year change in Online Channel net revenue by adding a ratio derived from Daily Store Sales (total transaction count divided by total average transaction value). Use it when you want an online revenue YoY view that is augmented by store transaction activity within the current filter context.
metrics.title: YoY: Net Revenue — Online Channel (+Transaction Count (Daily Store Sales)/Avg Transaction Value (Daily Store Sales))

metrics.description: Measures the month-over-month change in Online Channel net revenue, then adjusts it by adding the ratio of total average transaction value (from Daily Store Sales) to total blended revenue. Use this metric to track monthly online revenue movement while factoring in transaction value relative to overall revenue in the same reporting context.
metrics.title: MoM: Net Revenue — Online Channel (+Avg Transaction Value (Daily Store Sales)/Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue))

metrics.description: Calculates the year-over-year change in Net Revenue for the North region, then adjusts it by adding the ratio of Total Revenue (from Blended Daily Revenue) to Total Net Revenue (from Net Sales Summary) for the same reporting context. Use this metric to monitor North-region Net Revenue growth while factoring in how gross revenue compares to net revenue in the period being analyzed.
metrics.title: YoY: Net Revenue — North Region (+Revenue (Blended Daily Revenue)/Net Revenue (Net Sales Summary))

metrics.description: Combines the month-over-month change in Net Revenue for the North region with an adjustment based on the ratio of total Net Revenue (from Net Sales Summary) to total Operating Expense Transaction Amount. Use it to monitor North-region revenue momentum while normalizing or scaling the change against operating expense activity in the current report or dashboard context.
metrics.title: MoM: Net Revenue — North Region (+Net Revenue (Net Sales Summary)/Amount (Operating Expense Transaction))

metrics.description: Composite metric that adjusts the year-over-year change in in-store loyalty redemption discount amounts by adding the average operating expense transaction amount per gift card transaction. Use it to evaluate YoY discount performance alongside an expense-per-gift-card-transaction factor in a single view.
metrics.title: YoY: Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS) — In-Store Channel (+Amount (Operating Expense Transaction)/Transaction Count (Gift Card Transaction))

metrics.description: Combines the month-over-month change in in-store POS loyalty redemption discount amount with an added ratio of gift card transaction volume to loyalty points redeemed. Use it to track how discount trends shift month to month while also factoring in transaction activity relative to redemption volume.
metrics.title: MoM: Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS) — In-Store Channel (+Transaction Count (Gift Card Transaction)/Points Redeemed (Loyalty Points Redeemed))

metrics.description: Combines the year-over-year change in online loyalty redemption discount amount with an adjustment based on the ratio of total loyalty points redeemed to total price change from price adjustments. Use it to assess how online loyalty discount performance versus last year shifts when considering redemption volume and pricing adjustment impact.
metrics.title: YoY: Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS) — Online Channel (+Points Redeemed (Loyalty Points Redeemed)/Price Change (Price Adjustment))

metrics.description: Calculates a month-over-month view of online loyalty redemption discount amounts, then adjusts it by adding the ratio of total Price Change (Price Adjustment) to total Variance Amount (Till Reconciliation). Use this metric to monitor how online loyalty discount trends shift month to month while factoring in pricing adjustments relative to till reconciliation discrepancies.
metrics.title: MoM: Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS) — Online Channel (+Price Change (Price Adjustment)/Variance Amount (Till Reconciliation))

metrics.description: Composite metric that combines the year-over-year change in loyalty redemption discount amount at the point of sale for the North region with a variance-per-comment adjustment based on till reconciliation variance amount divided by compliment/complaint comment count. Use it to track YoY discount performance while factoring in operational variance relative to customer feedback volume.
metrics.title: YoY: Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS) — North Region (+Variance Amount (Till Reconciliation)/Comment Count (Compliment Complaint))

metrics.description: Combines the North Region month-over-month change in loyalty redemption discount amount at the point of sale with a normalized customer-feedback component, calculated as total compliment/complaint comment count divided by total aged-inventory days. Use it as a composite indicator to track changes in redemption discounts while factoring in comment volume relative to overall inventory aging.
metrics.title: MoM: Discount Amount (Loyalty Redemption at POS) — North Region (+Comment Count (Compliment Complaint)/Age Days (Aged Inventory))

metrics.description: A composite metric that adjusts the year-over-year change in in-store purchase order line item quantity by adding an inventory aging-to-competitor-price factor. Use it to relate in-store purchasing volume trends to overall inventory age days and competitor pricing levels in the same analysis.
metrics.title: YoY: Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items) — In-Store Channel (+Age Days (Aged Inventory)/Competitor Price (Competitor Pricing))

metrics.description: Measures the month-over-month change in in-store purchase order line-item quantity, then adjusts it by adding a competitor pricing-to-checkout-speed factor (total competitor price divided by total average checkout time in seconds). Use this metric to relate in-store volume trends to competitive pricing pressure and overall checkout efficiency under the same filters and breakdowns.
metrics.title: MoM: Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items) — In-Store Channel (+Competitor Price (Competitor Pricing)/Avg Checkout Time (sec) (Checkout Time))

metrics.description: Combines the year-over-year change in online purchase order line-item quantity with a checkout-efficiency-to-loyalty-revenue factor, adding average checkout time (in seconds) relative to total loyalty program attributed revenue. Use it as a composite indicator to assess how online volume trends relate to checkout performance and loyalty-driven revenue over the same reporting scope.
metrics.title: YoY: Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items) — Online Channel (+Avg Checkout Time (sec) (Checkout Time)/Attributed Revenue (Loyalty Program ROI))

metrics.description: Combines North-region year-over-year change in daily store sales transaction count with a purchase order value indicator calculated as total PO count divided by total PO amount. Use it to view sales-transaction growth alongside purchasing activity efficiency in a single metric for comparative analysis over time.
metrics.title: YoY: Transaction Count (Daily Store Sales) — North Region (+PO Count (Purchase Order)/PO Amount (Purchase Order))

metrics.description: Combines the month-over-month change in daily store sales transaction count for the North region with a purchasing spend ratio, calculated as total PO amount divided by total purchase order line amount. Use it to view North-region transaction momentum alongside how purchase order header totals compare to line-item totals in the same analysis.
metrics.title: MoM: Transaction Count (Daily Store Sales) — North Region (+PO Amount (Purchase Order)/Line Amount (Purchase Order Line Items))

sql.statement:
SELECT
    COALESCE(oh.order_date, woh.order_date) AS order_date,
    oh.store_id AS store_id,
    cm.channel_type,
    SUM(COALESCE(ol.revenue, wol.revenue)) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(oh.order_id, woh.order_id)) AS order_count
FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_header oh
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_line ol ON oh.order_id = ol.order_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.dim_channel_master cm ON oh.channel_id = cm.channel_id
FULL OUTER JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_web_order_header woh ON oh.order_date = woh.order_date
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_web_order_line wol ON woh.order_id = wol.order_id
WHERE COALESCE(oh.order_date, woh.order_date) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

sql.statement:
SELECT
    lp.enrollment_id AS loyalty_program_id,
    lp.enrollment_date AS program_date,
    SUM(lpe.points) * 0.01 AS points_cost,
    SUM(COALESCE(ol.revenue, 0)) AS attributed_revenue
FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_loyalty_points_earned lpe
JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_loyalty_enrollment lp ON lpe.customer_id = lp.customer_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_header oh ON lpe.customer_id = oh.customer_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_line ol ON oh.order_id = ol.order_id
GROUP BY 1, 2

sql.statement:
SELECT
    oh.order_date,
    oh.store_id,
    SUM(ol.revenue) - SUM(COALESCE(ret.return_amount, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(md.markdown_amount, 0)) AS net_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oh.order_id) AS order_count
FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_header oh
JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_line ol ON oh.order_id = ol.order_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_returns ret ON ol.order_id = ret.order_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_markdown_event md ON ol.product_id = md.product_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
